thread:
tim_customer: Hey support, our March invoice jumped from ~$600 to ~$6,000 overnight. Dashboard shows normal token usage. Can you check? Account: brighthealth-prod (acct_98765).

maria_support: Ack — sorry about that. Can you DM the invoice number? We'll open an investigation.

tim_customer: Invoice INV-2026-03-15. Dashboard metrics at 2026-03-15 show no spike in tokens. Billing shows 10x tokens.

maria_support: Thanks. Looping in billing + infra. @kevin_billing @raj_engineer

kevin_billing: Looking at invoice, ledger shows large batch of 'generation' line items at 03:22 UTC. Need request IDs / run_ids to correlate.

raj_engineer: I'll pull ingestion logs + metering events. Possible cause: SDK streaming reconnect created duplicate finalize events.

maria_support: Customer says they didn't change app. Any quick repro steps?

raj_engineer: Checking: around 03:22 we had retries from IP 52.14.22.34 for acct_98765. The ingestion service emitted two 'usage.finalize' events for same run_id because the SDK client retried while previous websocket had slow ACK. Snippet from logs:
```
run_id=abc123 finalize called, tokens=10240
run_id=abc123 finalize called, tokens=10240
```
We should dedupe by run_id but currently dedupe window (30s) missed due to clock skew during rotating workers.

kevin_billing: If that's true customer was charged twice. Finance, what is provisional credit process?

olivia_finance: We can apply provisional credit and create a RevRec adjustment. Need customer consent for provisional credit and an internal adjustment note with ledger id. I'll prepare credit of $5440 matching duplicate token charges. Please confirm token counts.

maria_support: Tim — can you confirm you want a provisional refund while we fix the dedupe?

tim_customer: Yes please, we'd like a refund. This blocks month-end reconciliation.

raj_engineer: Root cause: SDK lib v0.9.2 has a reconnect bug. Fix: 1) dedupe by run_id at ingestion and 2) bump dedupe window and add idempotency token. I'll open PR and deploy canary tonight.

sophie_pm: Please include postmortem action items and notify customers with affected invoices. Also, we need an automated alert when per-account token delta > 100% vs 24h baseline.

olivia_finance: Credit prepared. Internal adjustment note: 'REVREC-ADJ acct_98765 INV-2026-03-15 duplicate finalize events; provisional credit $5440; ledger_adj_20260315_001'. Applying now.

kevin_billing: Applied credit. Customer invoice updated to show negative adjustment line and new balance. Please confirm receipt.

tim_customer: Received credit, invoice looks right. Thanks for fast move.

maria_support: Closing loop. Raj, please post PR link and rollout ETA. Keep finance in loop for final RevRec entry once fix is in prod.

raj_engineer: PR: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/1789 — canary deploys completed 2026-03-16 02:10 UTC, full rollout scheduled 2026-03-16 04:00 UTC.

olivia_finance: Final RevRec note to post to accounting: 'Final adj posted 2026-03-16, reversal of duplicate consumption; credit settled to customer acct_98765, GL 6102-COGS reversal.' Marking case resolved.

maria_support: :white_check_mark: resolved. Closing thread.
